newsitem.title: DUBAI: Britain's Prince Charles arrives in Saudi Arabia.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Prince Charles arrives in Saudi Arabia.

text.p: Britain's Prince Charles arrived in Saudi Arabia on Wednesday for a two-day visit to meet senior Saudi princes and businessmen, the British embassy in Riyadh said.
He was also due to visit Saudi Arabia's consultative Shura Council and meet members of the British community in the kingdom, the embassy said in a statement.
Prince Charles recently visited Saudi Arabia's Gulf Arab neighbours Kuwait, Bahrain and Qatar.
